name: Certificate Chain Repairer
description: Pick the missing links from the given intermediates and trusted roots to complete a certificate chain.

examples.label: Complete a leaf certificate chain with the intermediate CA

hints.local: **Purely local**: it only picks from the collections you supply and never downloads missing certificates.
hints.order: Intermediate certificates are used first, trusted roots second.
hints.limit: Each input holds up to 64 certificates.

faq.a: No. It only picks from the intermediates and trusted roots you pass in.
The chain ends at a self-signed root or a trusted root, so the chain is complete.

faq.q: What is listed under "sources of the additions"?
faq.a: Where each added certificate came from: intermediates or trustedRoots.
